data.gender_notes: Nafesa is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word 'nafas', meaning breath or wind. The name evokes images of the delicate, soft, and fragile beauty of nature. It represents the gentle and graceful qualities of a person, reminding us of the sweetness and softness of life. The name Nafesa carries the meaning “Delicacy, sweetness, softness” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Pashto. Parents who choose Nafesa usually hope their child will grow to embody delicacy, sweetness, softness and live with faith, good character and purpose.
